title: The Uniform of the Lower Danube
author: Wendell Amberdale
blurb: Sebastian Ravensworth, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
